thirdPartyConfig.field.proxy.label: Proxy
thirdPartyConfig.field.proxy.description: Route only this source through its own proxy. Leave on the global proxy unless this one needs different routing.
thirdPartyConfig.tip.bilibili: Configure Bilibili downloader settings including cookie authentication and download parameters.
thirdPartyConfig.tip.exhentai: Configure ExHentai downloader settings. Cookie is required for authentication.
thirdPartyConfig.exHentai.originalImages: Original images may also be WebP. Downloading originals may spend GP; if GP runs out, the site may automatically convert Credits into GP.

This global setting applies to image downloads, including the task menu's Direct download action. Original-image downloads follow the configured maximum concurrency. The existing torrent preference still applies.
When GP spending is disabled, download originals only when they can be confirmed free. Otherwise stop and keep downloaded files, without switching to the page image.

Free downloads are checked using the gallery publication date and site time. Donator benefits and remaining Full Image Quota (FIQ) are not yet checked, so some requests that are actually free may also be stopped.
If there is no original-image link, download the image displayed on the page. It may be resampled or WebP and cannot be guaranteed to be the original.
Allow GP spending for original images

Check the balance before each potentially paid original request; stop if this request's reservation would leave less than this amount. Concurrent requests may reduce the actual balance below it. Set to 0 to keep no extra balance. Clearing restores the default of 10000.

Conservatively estimated from original size and quota refill batches; reservations may exceed actual spending. Exceeding this limit stops the task. This is not a site-enforced spending cap. Set to 0 to block potentially paid requests. Clearing restores the default of 100000.

Check spending permission, balance and the task's GP reservation limit before each original request. Unknown costs or failed checks stop the task and keep downloaded files. Stopping the task or reaching a limit does not prevent charges from parallel requests already sent; the site may still convert Credits automatically. The app never actively resets quota or converts points.

thirdPartyConfig.steam.language.label: Language
thirdPartyConfig.steam.language.descript: Affects all data fetched from Steam, including sync and metadata (game name, description, tags, etc.). Leave empty to auto-detect from app language.
thirdPartyConfig.autoSync.intervalDescri: How often to automatically sync data from this source. Set to 0 or leave empty to disable.
thirdPartyConfig.autoSync.warning: Setting a very short interval may cause your account to be rate-limited or blocked by the service provider.
thirdPartyConfig.recommendedDir.title: Use recommended directory?
thirdPartyConfig.recommendedDir.descript: We recommend using a dedicated subdirectory to keep files organized.
thirdPartyConfig.field.defaultPath.label: Default Download Path
thirdPartyConfig.field.defaultPath.descr: Default path where downloaded files will be saved.
thirdPartyConfig.field.maxConcurrency.de: Maximum number of concurrent requests. Higher values may speed up data fetching but could trigger rate limiting.
thirdPartyConfig.field.requestInterval.d: Minimum time between requests in milliseconds. Helps avoid rate limiting.
thirdPartyConfig.field.maxRetries.descri: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed requests.
thirdPartyConfig.field.requestTimeout.de: Maximum time to wait for a response before timing out.
Define how downloaded files and folders should be named. Use available variables below.
thirdPartyConfig.tip.cookieCapturedHereU: The sign-in window opens on this machine, so the site sees this machine's address. The requests that use the cookie afterwards are made by the server, from its address — a site that ties a session to one address will refuse them.
Obtaining a torrent does not download its contents. Choose a workflow to continue the BT download as each gallery result becomes ready. The built-in workflow only downloads files; duplicate it and add organization and materialization steps if you want to add them to your library.

Applies to new standalone downloader tasks; existing tasks keep their original setting. Tasks started from Get resources continue in their original workflow. If BT fails, retry the follow-up workflow from the task’s download results without fetching the torrent again.
